title: Grateful Dead Live at Moscone Convention Center on 1982-05-28
lineage: Cassette > Nakamichi Dragon > RCA/XLR > Lunatec V3 (@ 2496) > coax > Audiophile 2496 > WaveLab 5.0 > .wav @ 2496 > Wave L3 UltraMaximizer > .wav @ 16/44.1 > CD Wave Editor > Trader's Little Helper > FLAC(8).

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording with uneven sound but captures a high‑energy show highlighted by a scorching Boz Scaggs blues set.
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered for its ferocious second half and a blistering Boz Scaggs/blues segment, with Althea and Lovelight also getting strong mentions. While the recording suffers from venue‑related flatness and spotty audibility in the early songs, several listeners praise its overall strength and clarity when captured from a good position.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (13/4 = 3.25) combined with enthusiastic comments about the performance but mixed remarks on sound quality leads to a mid‑range score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers note flat, uneven venue sound and difficulty hearing early songs unless positioned close to the stage; others describe the recording as strong when captured from a good spot.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early portion was hampered by poor venue acoustics, but the band surged into a high‑gear second half with tight transitions and strong blues energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Backed to audience then stood at front of drum riser for an open riff into "God's Country"; noted for fast playing and minimal tuning issues.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill counted off from the drum riser; no specific drumming performance comments beyond stage positioning.
